# Command reference / 命令与参数

<!-- Generated by go generate ./packages/clihelp; edit the Go catalog. -->

Use `coconet --help`, `coconet help connect` or `coconet history preview --help`. All commands accept `--help` or `-h`; `coconet help` shows the overview. The server supports the same help forms. Runtime help needs no login or connected folder, writes to stdout, exits successfully and does not run the selected operation. Unknown topics exit with status 2.

README 保留快速上手说明；本页列出公开命令、参数、默认值、适用条件和示例。Runtime 帮助无需登录或连接项目，不调用 Agent、不访问服务器，也不修改本地状态。命令行说明使用英文。首次通过 npm 启动或切换版本时，启动器仍需先完成 Runtime 的下载安装。

Put flags after the command/subcommand. Required positional arguments such as `agent add claude` precede flags. Most commands accept `--flag VALUE` or `--flag=VALUE`; boolean flags may use `--flag=false`. The small `health` and `mcp` entry points accept only the exact option forms shown in their usage. `--` ends option parsing. Paths containing spaces must be quoted. Replace example IDs and paths with your own. Group option tables state which subcommands use each parameter; a parameter is not global.

普通工作流沿用 Agent 的默认模型，无需设置模型或调用次数。服务端 OAuth、对象存储和容量策略使用环境变量，见 [self-hosting](../README.md#self-hosted-relay--自部署)；它们不是 CLI 参数。[集成与调试命令](cli-internal.md) 单独列出。

### `coconet connect`

Connect this folder; choose or create a project in your browser

```sh
coconet connect [PROJECT_ID] [options]
```

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--path DIRECTORY` | — | Folder to connect; defaults to the current directory (Git subdirectories use the repository root) |
| `--project ID` | — | Preselect a coco_ project ID; equivalent to positional PROJECT_ID |
| `--server URL` | — | Server origin; otherwise use the folder's server, COCONET_SERVER_URL, or https://api.coconet.space |
| `--new` | false | Create a new project directly; mutually exclusive with a project ID |
| `--no-browser` | false | Print the connection link without opening a browser; also automatic over SSH |
| `--verbose` | false | Show account, connection and local processing details |

A connected folder remembers its server. Disconnect before changing its project or server. Existing history is not imported automatically.

Supply PROJECT_ID before flags, or after all flags; flags after a trailing PROJECT_ID are not parsed. Browser sign-in may still be required with --new.

```sh
coconet connect
coconet connect coco_PROJECT_ID --server https://coconet.example.com --no-browser
coconet connect --path '/path/to/work folder'
```

### `coconet agent`

Inspect and manage Agent integrations

```sh
coconet agent <list|add|remove>
```

#### `coconet agent list`

List registered Agent integrations

```sh
coconet agent list [options]
```

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--json` | false | Write machine-readable JSON |
| `--verbose` | false | Show commands, configuration paths and setup errors |

```sh
coconet agent list --verbose
```

#### `coconet agent add`

Install or retry the plugin for an Agent

```sh
coconet agent add <codex|claude> [options]
```

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--command CMD` | — | Agent executable; defaults to the chosen Agent name (codex or claude) |
| `--config-root DIR` | — | Absolute Agent profile directory; defaults to the chosen Agent's normal profile |
| `--json` | false | Write machine-readable JSON |

```sh
coconet agent add claude --command tclaude --config-root /path/to/claude-profile
```

#### `coconet agent remove`

Remove one registered Coconet integration

```sh
coconet agent remove <integration-id> [options]
```

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--json` | false | Write machine-readable JSON |

Choose the integration ID from agent list. Native Agent conversation history is preserved.

### `coconet inference`

Inspect, pause or resume automatic local processing

```sh
coconet inference <status|pause|resume>
```

Uses each source Agent's sign-in and configured default model. No separate model or call-budget configuration is needed.

```sh
coconet inference status
```

#### `coconet inference status`

Show automatic inference configuration and pause state

```sh
coconet inference status
```

#### `coconet inference pause`

Pause local model processing

```sh
coconet inference pause
```

#### `coconet inference resume`

Resume local model processing

```sh
coconet inference resume
```

### `coconet history`

Preview and import explicitly selected historical sessions

```sh
coconet history <command> [options]
```

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--plan ID` | — | Required except for preview/list; take the exact plan ID from preview or list |
| `--agent codex\|claude` | — | Required for preview: native history provider |
| `--sessions ID,ID` | — | Required for start: comma-separated native Session IDs selected from the preview |
| `--batch-size N` | 5 | start: selected sessions per batch, 1-20; resume starts the next batch |
| `--json` | false | Write machine-readable JSON |

Run in a connected folder. Import is explicit, uses the Agent's default model and consumes its model allowance.

```sh
coconet history preview --agent claude
coconet history start --plan PLAN_ID --sessions SESSION_A,SESSION_B --batch-size 2
```

#### `coconet history preview`

Preview eligible history without importing it

```sh
coconet history preview --agent codex|claude [--json]
```

#### `coconet history list`

List existing import plans

```sh
coconet history list [--json]
```

#### `coconet history status`

Inspect a selected import plan

```sh
coconet history status --plan ID [--json]
```

#### `coconet history start`

Import selected sessions in batches

```sh
coconet history start --plan ID --sessions ID,ID [--batch-size N] [--json]
```

#### `coconet history pause`

Pause an import plan

```sh
coconet history pause --plan ID [--json]
```

An in-flight model call or publication may finish; pause prevents new calls.

#### `coconet history resume`

Resume the plan and advance to its next batch

```sh
coconet history resume --plan ID [--json]
```

#### `coconet history retry`

Retry failed fixed inputs in a plan

```sh
coconet history retry --plan ID [--json]
```

#### `coconet history forget`

Remove local plan metadata

```sh
coconet history forget --plan ID [--json]
```

Only completed plans or unstarted previews can be removed. Published work and native Agent histories are preserved.

### `coconet projection`

Inspect processing progress and retry a selected failure

```sh

```

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--json` | false | Write machine-readable JSON |

| `--capture ID` | — | retry: exact paused capture event |

```sh
coconet projection status

```

Show capture, model, publication and transfer status

```sh
coconet projection status [--json]
```

#### `coconet projection retry`


Choose exactly one selector from projection status. Existing processing limits still apply.

### `coconet diagnostics`

Inspect and manage local processing records

```sh
coconet diagnostics <command> [options]
```

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--root DIR` | — | Absolute private Runtime store; otherwise use the connected folder |
| `--project ID` | — | Project ID when selecting an explicit Runtime store |
| `--run ID` | — | Required for pin/unpin/export: run ID from diagnostics list |
| `--output FILE` | — | Required for export: new file; existing files are never overwritten |
| `--include-content` | false | export: also include private prompt inputs and model outputs |
| `--days N` | 7 | configure: retention of unpinned full archives, 1-365 days |
| `--max-mib N` | 256 | configure: archive limit including reserved response space, 32-16384 MiB |
| `--before CURSOR` | — | list: previous page cursor |
| `--limit N` | 50 | list: records per page, 1-100 |

Retention is shared by the account and deployment. With --root, list/pin/unpin/export also require --project. Output is JSON.

```sh
coconet diagnostics list --limit 20
coconet diagnostics export --run RUN_ID --output ./diagnostic.json
```

#### `coconet diagnostics status`

Show diagnostic retention and usage

```sh
coconet diagnostics status [options]
```

#### `coconet diagnostics list`

List processing records

```sh
coconet diagnostics list [--limit N] [--before CURSOR] [options]
```

#### `coconet diagnostics configure`

Set archive retention limits

```sh
coconet diagnostics configure [--days N] [--max-mib N] [options]
```

Omitted settings use the defaults shown above.

#### `coconet diagnostics pin`

Retain one selected processing archive

```sh
coconet diagnostics pin --run ID [options]
```

#### `coconet diagnostics unpin`

Allow normal retention for a selected archive

```sh
coconet diagnostics unpin --run ID [options]
```

#### `coconet diagnostics export`

Export one processing record

```sh
coconet diagnostics export --run ID --output FILE [--include-content] [options]
```

Export excludes private content unless explicitly requested. Review any export before sharing it.

#### `coconet diagnostics prune`

Apply diagnostic retention rules

```sh
coconet diagnostics prune [options]
```

### `coconet storage`

Manage local replicas, limits and offline archives

```sh
coconet storage <command> [options]
```

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--root DIR` | — | Absolute private Runtime store; otherwise use the connected folder |
| `--project ID` | — | Project ID when selecting an explicit Runtime store |
| `--file FILE` | — | Required for export/restore: absolute path to a private replica archive |
| `--max-mib N` | 16384 | configure: session-content limit, 16-1048576 MiB; omitted values preserve existing settings |
| `--exports-mib N` | 1024 | configure: derived-file limit, 16-1048576 MiB; separate from content blocks |

Limits are shared by the account and deployment. With --root, reindex/export/restore also require --project. Output is JSON.

```sh
coconet storage status
coconet storage configure --max-mib 8192
coconet storage export --file /absolute/project-backup.tar
```

#### `coconet storage status`

Show local storage usage and limits

```sh
coconet storage status [options]
```

#### `coconet storage configure`

Update selected storage limits

```sh
coconet storage configure [--max-mib N] [--exports-mib N] [options]
```

#### `coconet storage prune`

Reclaim unused Coconet content and derived files

```sh
coconet storage prune [options]
```

Does not delete native Agent conversation history.

#### `coconet storage reindex`

Rebuild the project's local search index

```sh
coconet storage reindex [options]
```

#### `coconet storage export`

Archive the project graph and retained local content

```sh
coconet storage export --file /absolute/archive.tar [options]
```

Requires all retained content to be present and a new output file. Excludes credentials, unpublished tasks and private model archives.

#### `coconet storage restore`

Restore a private replica archive

```sh
coconet storage restore --file /absolute/archive.tar [options]
```

For a connected project, restores content against the current graph without rewinding it. An explicit new --root and --project can create a separate offline recovery store.

### `coconet session`

Read or continue a fixed source selected from the DAG

```sh
coconet session <read|pull|resume> [options]
```

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--node ID` | — | Required for a fixed source: select a current DAG node |
| `--session ID` | — | Required for a fixed source: use that node's Session ID |
| `--version N` | 0 | Required for a fixed source: use that node's positive version number |
| `--project ID` | — | Required: expected project ID; must match this folder's connection |
| `--agent codex\|claude` | — | Required for resume and invalid for read/pull; selects the target Agent |
| `--include-artifact` | false | read/pull: also materialize the native session artifact |
| `--request-id ID` | — | resume only: generated if omitted; retry with the printed ID and all original arguments |

Select --node, --session and --version together from the current DAG. Withdrawn or unavailable sources are rejected, never silently replaced.

#### `coconet session read`

Print compact conversation JSONL

```sh
coconet session read --project ID --node ID --session ID --version N [--include-artifact]
```

#### `coconet session pull`

Return local source paths and metadata as JSON

```sh
coconet session pull --project ID --node ID --session ID --version N [--include-artifact]
```

#### `coconet session resume`

Create a separate native continuation; equivalent to fork

```sh
coconet session resume --project ID --node ID --session ID --version N --agent codex|claude [--request-id ID]
```

### `coconet library`

List or update collected fixed session sources

```sh
coconet library <list|add|remove> [options]
```

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--node ID` | — | Required for a fixed source: select a current DAG node |
| `--session ID` | — | Required for a fixed source: use that node's Session ID |
| `--version N` | 0 | Required for a fixed source: use that node's positive version number |
| `--request-id ID` | — | Generated if omitted; on retry reuse the printed ID and all original arguments |
| `--note TEXT` | — | add: optional collection purpose; preserve it when retrying the request |
| `--limit N` | 50 | list: nodes per page, 1-100 |
| `--cursor CURSOR` | — | list: next_cursor from the same selection |
| `--json` | false | Write machine-readable JSON |

Run in a connected folder. Collection updates are shared with the Dashboard star state.

#### `coconet library list`

List collected sources

```sh
coconet library list [--limit N] [--cursor CURSOR] [--json]
```

#### `coconet library add`

Collect a node's fixed session source

```sh
coconet library add --node ID --session ID --version N [--request-id ID] [--note TEXT] [--json]
```

#### `coconet library remove`

Remove a source from the collection

```sh
coconet library remove --node ID --session ID --version N [--request-id ID] [--json]
```

### `coconet fork`

Create an independent native session from a selected source

```sh
coconet fork --agent codex|claude --node ID --session ID --version N [options]
```

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--node ID` | — | Required for a fixed source: select a current DAG node |
| `--session ID` | — | Required for a fixed source: use that node's Session ID |
| `--version N` | 0 | Required for a fixed source: use that node's positive version number |
| `--agent codex\|claude` | — | Required: target Agent; Codex and Claude sources support cross-Agent text continuation |
| `--request-id ID` | — | Generated if omitted; on retry reuse the printed ID and all original arguments |
| `--json` | false | Write machine-readable JSON |

Run in a connected folder. Uses retained local source content, preserves the original history and prints a native continuation command. Same-Agent Fork preserves native history; cross-Agent Fork imports user/assistant text, excluding tools, reasoning and media. Publication can finish later in the background.

```sh
coconet fork --agent claude --node NODE_ID --session SESSION_ID --version 3
```

### `coconet version`

### `coconet uninstall`

Remove Coconet and its Agent integrations

```sh
coconet uninstall [options]
```

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--root DIR` | — | Install root; defaults to $XDG_DATA_HOME/coconet or ~/.local/share/coconet |
| `--bin-dir DIR` | — | Archive-install executable directory; defaults to $XDG_BIN_HOME or ~/.local/bin |
| `--purge` | false | Also remove Coconet local state, replicas and credentials; native Agent histories are preserved |
| `--json` | false | Write machine-readable JSON |

Without --purge, Coconet state and credentials are retained. Remove the npm launcher afterwards; invoking it again otherwise reinstalls the Runtime.

```sh
coconet uninstall
npm uninstall -g coconet
```

### `coconet init`

Alias for connect

```sh
coconet init [PROJECT_ID] [options]
```

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--path DIRECTORY` | — | Folder to connect; defaults to the current directory (Git subdirectories use the repository root) |
| `--project ID` | — | Preselect a coco_ project ID; equivalent to positional PROJECT_ID |
| `--server URL` | — | Server origin; otherwise use the folder's server, COCONET_SERVER_URL, or https://api.coconet.space |
| `--new` | false | Create a new project directly; mutually exclusive with a project ID |
| `--no-browser` | false | Print the connection link without opening a browser; also automatic over SSH |
| `--verbose` | false | Show account, connection and local processing details |

A connected folder remembers its server. Disconnect before changing its project or server. Existing history is not imported automatically.

Supply PROJECT_ID before flags, or after all flags; flags after a trailing PROJECT_ID are not parsed. Browser sign-in may still be required with --new.

```sh
coconet init --no-browser
```

## coconet-server

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [init](#coconet-server-init) | Initialize a deployment without starting the server |
| [serve](#coconet-server-serve) | Start the Relay HTTP service |
| [status](#coconet-server-status) | Inspect the configured deployment |
| [backup](#coconet-server-backup) | Create a complete deployment backup |
| [restore](#coconet-server-restore) | Restore and verify a deployment backup |
| [compact](#coconet-server-compact) | Write a compacted copy of the metadata database |
| [account](#coconet-server-account) | Local operator account management |
| [version](#coconet-server-version) | Show the server version (aliases: --version, -v) |

### `coconet-server init`

Initialize a deployment without starting the server

```sh
coconet-server init --data-dir DIR --advertised-endpoint URL [options]
```

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--data-dir DIR` | — | Required: persistent deployment directory |
| `--advertised-endpoint URL` | — | Required: canonical client-facing server origin |
| `--listen ADDRESS` | 127.0.0.1:8080 | HTTP listen address |
| `--artifact-store filesystem\|s3` | filesystem | Conversation transfer storage driver |
| `--artifact-path DIR` | — | Absolute filesystem artifact directory; defaults to DATA_DIR/artifacts; invalid with s3 |

Creates server.json, deployment identity and metadata. Refuses to replace an initialized deployment. Configure login and S3 credentials through the documented environment variables.

```sh
coconet-server init --data-dir /var/lib/coconet --advertised-endpoint https://coconet.example.com
```

### `coconet-server serve`

Start the Relay HTTP service

```sh
coconet-server serve --config FILE
```

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--config FILE` | — | Required: server.json created by init or a completed deployment restore |

```sh
coconet-server serve --config /var/lib/coconet/server.json
```

### `coconet-server status`

Inspect the configured deployment

```sh
coconet-server status --config FILE
```

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--config FILE` | — | Required: server.json created by init or a completed deployment restore |

This is a local deployment inspection, not a remote health probe.

### `coconet-server backup`

Create a complete deployment backup

```sh
coconet-server backup --config FILE --output FILE
```

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--config FILE` | — | Required: server.json created by init or a completed deployment restore |
| `--output FILE` | — | Required: new backup file |

Includes identity, metadata and objects still retained by the server. Expired transfer objects require member replicas or client archives; a server backup cannot recreate them. Stop the server first unless using the documented operator-socket backup workflow.

```sh
coconet-server backup --config /var/lib/coconet/server.json --output /safe/path/deployment-backup.tar
```

### `coconet-server restore`

Restore and verify a deployment backup

```sh
coconet-server restore --input FILE (--data-dir DIR | --config FILE)
```

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--input FILE` | — | Required: validated backup file |
| `--data-dir DIR` | — | New empty destination for a complete deployment restore; mutually exclusive with --config |
| `--config FILE` | — | Legacy metadata-only restore target; mutually exclusive with --data-dir |

Use --data-dir for current complete backups. --config only supports legacy metadata-only deployments. Stop the server before restoring; retain the previous directory for rollback.

```sh
coconet-server restore --input /safe/path/deployment-backup.tar --data-dir /var/lib/coconet-restored
```

### `coconet-server compact`

Write a compacted copy of the metadata database

```sh
coconet-server compact --config FILE --output FILE
```

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--config FILE` | — | Required: server.json created by init or a completed deployment restore |
| `--output FILE` | — | Required: new compacted database path |

Stop the server first. The original database remains in place; this is not a complete deployment backup.

### `coconet-server account`

Local operator account management

```sh
coconet-server account <create>
```

#### `coconet-server account create`

Create an account and print its private account key

```sh
coconet-server account create --config FILE --name NAME
```

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--config FILE` | — | Required: server.json created by init or a completed deployment restore |
| `--name NAME` | — | Required: valid, nonempty user display name |

For deployments using account-key login. Requires local operator access; stdout contains a credential. Stop the running server before direct database access.

### `coconet-server version`

Show the server version (aliases: --version, -v)

```sh
coconet-server version
```
